prompt: Create a stylish watercolor-and-ink portrait of a handsome adult man shown from the chest up in a relaxed three-quarter pose, looking slightly upward and to the viewer’s left. He has medium tan skin, a strong jawline, defined cheekbones, a full dark beard and mustache, and tousled shoulder-length black hair escaping from under a wide-brim woven straw sun hat. He wears round silver-framed mirrored sunglasses with bright blue lenses reflecting a tropical beach scene with palm trees and sky. Outfit: a light blue faded denim jacket with visible seams, stitching, metal buttons, and two chest pockets over an open-collar crisp white shirt, plus one brown leather crossbody strap with a small metal buckle crossing diagonally over the chest. Use expressive fine black ink linework, transparent watercolor washes, realistic facial proportions, detailed hair strands, textured straw crosshatching, soft shadows, and loose painterly edges. Background is clean white paper with scattered watercolor splashes and speckles in blue, tan, and brown around the portrait. Composition is vertical, centered, fashion editorial travel vibe, high detail, airy summer atmosphere, no text, no watermark.

promptZh: 创作一幅时尚的水彩墨水肖像，主角为一位 英俊的成年男性，采用半身像构图，呈现放松的三分之二侧面姿态，视线略微向上并看向观者的左侧。他拥有中等深浅的古铜色皮肤、轮廓分明的下颌线和颧骨、浓密的深色胡须和八字胡，凌乱的齐肩黑发从宽檐编织草帽下自然垂落。他佩戴着圆框银色反光墨镜，明亮的蓝色镜片映照出热带海滩、棕榈树和天空的景象。服装：一件浅蓝色水洗牛仔夹克，带有明显的接缝、缝线、金属纽扣和两个胸前口袋，内搭一件敞领的挺括白衬衫，胸前斜跨一条带有小型金属扣的棕色皮革背带。运用富有表现力的黑色细墨线条、透明水彩渲染、写实的脸部比例、细腻的发丝纹理、草帽的交叉阴影、柔和的阴影以及灵动的绘画边缘。背景为干净的白纸，肖像周围点缀着蓝色、棕褐色和棕色的水彩溅点。构图为竖向居中，呈现时尚杂志旅行风格，细节丰富，充满清爽的夏日氛围，无文字，无水印。
